name: modelwise
description: Stop using one AI model for everything. Type any prompt, from any team, and modelwise decides what an expert would deliver, picks the right Claude or OpenAI model and effort for each step, shows what it costs across models, and writes a prompt tuned for that model.

interface.longDescription: Stop using one AI model for everything. Type any prompt, from any team, and modelwise decides what an expert would deliver, picks the right Claude or OpenAI model and effort for each step, shows what it costs across models, and writes a prompt tuned for that model. Model facts come from a registry built only from the vendors' official docs, checked daily. No API keys, nothing collected; it runs locally.
defaultPrompt: Use modelwise: pricing page for our AI meeting-notes app
Use modelwise to find the cheapest way to classify 50,000 support tickets
Use modelwise: which model and effort for debugging a failing Next.js build?
